say:0:1460416001:1.text: According to Xera, most of the new patients are lethargic, prone to procrastination, and lack motivation to do anything.
say:0:1460416001:1.source_cn: 根据席蕾给出的消息，新的患者们大多懒散、拖延，甚至彻底...

say:1:1460416002:1.text: You decide to use what's available in the garden to prepare a recipe for them.
say:1:1460416002:1.source_cn: 你决定，从苗圃里现有的药材中挑选适合的来制作药剂。

say:2:1460416003:1.text: Let's start with some <style="highlight">frostcrystals</style> to lift the patient's spirit.

say:3:1460416004:1.text: Then, add some <style="highlight">glowfly fruits</style> to ignite the patient's motivation and help them find their way.
say:3:1460416004:1.source_cn: 接下来要加一些<style=highlight>灵感萤...

say:4:1460416005:1.text: Lastly, throw in some <style="highlight">jumping beans</style> for a kick. They will get even the laziest patients up and moving.

narration:5:1460416006:0.text: There it is—the recipe for the <style="highlight">Efficiency Extract</style>!
